captures.what_is_new: Commission, 10 Nov 2026: a targeted consultation (open 10 to 23 Nov 2026) on draft revised election guidelines under the Digital Services Act, for Very Large Online Platforms and Search Engines, addressing generative AI and information manipulation risks; the 2024 guidelines were adopted under Article 35 of the DSA; the draft proposes five main changes (the Commission's news item names stronger defences against foreign information manipulation, new expectations for recommender systems, adaptation to the evolving AI landscape, and better protection for political candidates). The Commission's news item is at digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/news/commission-invites-views-draft-revised-election-guidelines-under-digital-services-act.
